original_post_text: I’m running good on stream I think.
expanded_title: Running Good on the Poker House Fort Worth Livestream: Round of Each PLO and Congress
expanded_deck: Taking a seat on the Poker House Live feature table in Fort Worth for a mixed Round of Each session of Pot-Limit Omaha and 5-Card PLO (Congress) — and stacking up deep.
expanded_body:
Originally posted March 19, 2026.

Pulled up to Poker House Fort Worth to play on the Poker House Live stream (@POKERHOUSELIVESTREAM on YouTube) in a Round of Each mix of Pot-Limit Omaha (PLO) and Congress (5-Card PLO).

Once the action got rolling under the lights on the feature felt, the stacks started building fast. Looking down at the racks of red and green chips in front of me mid-session, I could only sum it up one way: I'm running good on stream, I think.

— Sham
author: Shomari Williams
